business_summary: Wuxi Xuelang Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. engages in environmental science and technology equipment manufacturing and water resource utilization in China. It provides flue gas treatment and purification, sludge, industrial, and medical hazardous waste incineration for domestic coastal areas, provincial capitals, and developed cities, as well as industrial wastewater and leachate treatment equipment; metallurgical environmental dust removal system, including baghouse, fixed hopper chain bucket machine, electric furnace dust collector, bucket elevator; batching dust removal system; combined conveying equipment; scraper conveyer, pneumatic conveying system of coke oven transfer station, movable hopper chain bucket machine, and flame cutting mobile trap hood; environmental protection and steel conveying equipment; and an industry development center. It is also involved in industrial investment for waste resource utilization. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Wuxi, China.
